question: What are the most influential papers on antibody-drug conjugates? Return 5 with DOIs and citation counts.
final_text: {"answer":"The most influential papers on antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), based on citation counts, include reviews on next-generation strategies, general antibody therapy in cancer, and specific studies on targeting HER2-positive breast cancer and site-specific conjugation techniques.","citations":[{"doi":"10.1038/nrd.2016.268","title":"Strategies and challenges for the next generation of antibody–drug conjugates","citation_count":1997},{"doi":"10.1038/nrc3236","title":"Antibody therapy of cancer","citation_count":1952},{"doi":"10.1158/0008-5472.can-08-1776","title":"Targeting HER2-Positive Breast Cancer with Trastuzumab-DM1, an Antibody–Cytotoxic Drug Conjugate","citation_count":1435},{"doi":"10.1038/nbt.1480","title":"Site-specific conjugation of a cytotoxic drug to an antibody improves the therapeutic index","citation_count":1227},{"doi":"10.1038/nbt832","title":"Development of potent monoclonal antibody auristatin conjugates for cancer therapy","citation_count":1108}]}

parsed.answer: The most influential papers on antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), based on citation counts, include reviews on next-generation strategies, general antibody therapy in cancer, and specific studies on targeting HER2-positive breast cancer and site-specific conjugation techniques.
